statement: There is no single parity gate: four automated entry points (pre-commit agent-mirror block + 6 checkers; spec-kit-check.yml with the same 6 plus sync-gate1-pointers; agent-mirror-sync.yml; command-tree-parity.yml) plus one manual read-only route (/doctor runtime-mirrors). Seventeen other workflows guard quality, not runtime parity.

The manual /doctor runtime-mirrors route covers strictly more than either automated gate: its upstream_assets include pi_agents and pi_prompts, which pre-commit and CI never run, and it carries a per-host hook-adapter fallback health table (file_exists per adapter behind every mkHookDrift chain) that detects degraded adapters rather than mirror shape.

Gate-by-gate blind spots: every existing checker asks 'is this mirror equal to its source?' and none asks 'does this runtime have a mirror for every surface that should reach it?' — so a whole surface can be absent while every gate passes, which is exactly the Devin command case. Additional named blind spots: token-set equality (agent bodies), change-scoped execution, Devin absent from command-tree parity, four --check modes invoked nowhere automatically, and no strict-YAML or Pi-extension checker.

Observed: command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs reports 'canonical: .opencode/commands frontmatter (35 commands)', 35/35 listed, STATUS=OK, exit 0 — independently confirming the iteration-1 correction to 35. Its own header comment still says 'the metadata covers 20 of the 39 shipped commands', so the checkers' prose drifts too.

Cheapest detector for the Devin command class: a surface-coverage assertion table (runtime x surface -> mirror | recorded exemption reason). The pattern already exists in agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs for the agents surface and in command-scope.cjs as the exemption registry for commands — but the latter is wired to generators, never used to assert coverage. Cost: one file walk, no new dependency, within the noise of the six checkers pre-commit already runs.

Second cheapest and broader: a strict-YAML frontmatter parse over every canonical agent and command file would catch the only silent failure class found in this research (Devin dropping files whose unquoted description contains a colon) and protects all seven runtimes at once.
The semantic agent-body divergence (deep-research.md) should not be automated: a similarity score would either fire constantly or miss it; the correct control is a review step.
